_comment: Every number the model uses lives here. Change a weight, push, and the next build uses it. Decision numbers (D2, D9...) refer to the feasibility study.

leagues.name: Jessica Alba Dynasty League
leagues._situations: Each manager's situation as Matt sees it on 2 October 2026. From Phase 3 it sets their default horizon (see situation_horizons); the test set uses it now.
leagues._qb_premium: Test-set lesson 2 (T1, B): JADL pays more for starting QBs than the Superflex market does. Raised from 1.10 to 1.30 on 2 October 2026 after current trade N4 (Drake Maye), then to 1.50 after batches 3 and 4 (N18, N22, N26, N29). It fades with age: see qb_premium_ages.

_horizons: D2. Shares of each ingredient at the three anchor points. The slider on the site blends between them. Each row adds up to 1. Picks have no points of their own: they get the market share of their value at Win Now and all of it at Balanced and Long-Term. Balanced changed on 2 October 2026 from 0.25/0.25/0/0.50 after current trades N1-N9: this season's points made veterans beat picks and young players, because the market had already priced their age. Batch 2 broadly confirmed it.
_qb_premium_ages: The league QB premium is for young QBs: full up to full_until, fading in a straight line to nothing at none_from. Added 2 October 2026 after N27 (Mayfield, 31) and N28 (Stafford, 38), where the premium made older QBs too valuable. To be checked by batch 5.
_situation_horizons: Where each situation sits on the horizon slider (0 = Win Now, 50 = Balanced, 100 = Long-Term). Matt: building is between Balanced and Long-Term. The model lab judges current test trades at these horizons.
_market: D3. Dynasty market = FantasyCalc (real trades) and DynastyProcess (experts), matched by rank then blended. Win Now uses FantasyCalc's redraft value as its market.
_points: D4. Baseline points per game = projection blended with the last three seasons (50/30/20). A past season played for a different NFL team counts at role_change_weight.
_age_curves: D5. Measured from Sleeper season stats: year-on-year change in half-PPR points per game for players who cleared both bars in both seasons. 'overrides' replaces a measured multiplier (1 = peak), e.g. {"RB": {"30": 0.5}}.

age_curves._overrides: Added 2 October 2026 after current trades N6 and N11 (old players valued above Matt's view and the market). Only players who kept playing are measured, so the old end of each curve is too gentle and the data runs thin. From the age where a position has fewer than about 15 season pairs, the decline carries on steadily instead. RB from 30, WR from 32, TE from 29 (the measured TE curve is flat from 29 to 32). QBs are left as measured.

_injuries: D11. Win Now only: the rest-of-season points are scaled by the player's Sleeper status. Suspensions are treated like injuries (test-set lesson 10).
_picks: D9 and test-set lessons 3-5. Picks are valued by overall pick number on the market's 12-team charts. Future years lose 10% a year, adjusted by Matt's class rating (-2 to +2). Only picks up to long_term_boost_through_overall get the Long-Term boost.
_kdef: D12. Kickers and defences get a small points-only value: points above replacement for the rest of the season times value_per_point, capped.
_star: D6, refined after test trades T1, T4, A and C. Pieces below the quality line count for less: a piece worth half the line counts value x 0.5^strength. The line is the value of the last starter if every team in the league filled its starting lineup (x quality_line_share_of_starters). With extra_pieces_only, only the side sending more pieces is touched, and only its weakest pieces beyond the other side's count, so 1-for-1 trades are never changed. Each step of a manager's star slider adds slider_step to strength.

star._strength: Switched off (0) on 2 October 2026. Across 33 current trades the rule never turned a miss into an agreement, and it caused misses in N23, N24 and N30. The market already prices stars above the sum of lesser players. Set back to 1.0 to restore it.
star._quality_line_share_of_starters: Was 1.0 (the 90th player, about a late 1st). Lowered to 1.5 on 2 October 2026 (about the 135th player, a mid-to-late 2nd) after N5 and N16, where Matt counts a single decent extra piece at close to full value.

_sliders: Manager sliders, -2 to +2 with 0 = neutral. Rookie optimism: each step +/- rookie_step on players in their first season (years of experience up to rookie_max_years_exp) and on the next draft's picks up to rookie_pick_rounds. Pick optimism: +/- pick_step on picks, plus pick_step_extra_per_year of that for each year further out. D15 extras: risk tolerance (+/- risk_step on injured players and those within risk_years_before_cliff of their position's age cliff), market trust (the market's share of the mix x (1 +/- market_trust_step)), Superflex QB premium (+/- qb_step on QBs) and TE premium confidence (+/- te_step on TEs).
_verdict: D7. The gap is (what a side gets - what it gives) / the larger of the two, so it runs from -100% to +100%. Under fair_below is Fair; then Slight edge, Clear win, and Fleece from clear_below up. Grades: the first threshold the gap reaches, else F.
